q: Two numbers are in the ratio 3 : 4 and their sum is 35. What is the larger number?
solution: There are 3 + 4 = 7 equal parts. Each part = 35 ÷ 7 = 5. The larger number is 4 parts: 4 × 5 = 20.

q: A car travels 60 km in 45 minutes. What is its speed in km per hour?
solution: 45 minutes is 3/4 of an hour. Speed = distance ÷ time = 60 ÷ (3/4) = 60 × 4/3 = 80 km/h.

q: If 5 workers build a wall in 12 days, how many days would 6 workers take at the same rate?
solution: The job takes 5 × 12 = 60 worker-days. With 6 workers: 60 ÷ 6 = 10 days. (More workers → fewer days — an inverse relationship.)

q: A shirt costs $20 after a 20% discount. What was the original price?
solution: $20 is 80% of the original price. So the original = 20 ÷ 0.80 = $25.
